Definition: properly, to cover up; used only figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. treacherously
BiblicalUsage: The word means to act treacherously, to cover up and deal falsely, and it is used of kings, priests and whole generations. Moses says Israel trespassed against God at the waters of Meribah, Achan's trespass brought defeat at Ai, and Uzziah trespassed against the LORD when he entered the temple to burn incense. Ezra confesses that the people had trespassed by taking foreign wives, and the prophets name the trespass again and again.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe acting treacherously is the sin of the heart that hides, because it covers what it does even from itself. I hold that no cover holds before God, and the only safe place is to uncover the sin and let Him cleanse it.
RelatedEvents: The Defeat at Ai and Achan's Sin
